business_problem: add fast, cost-effective compute for large operational analytics workloads inside BMW’s multi-vendor Cloud Data Hub without disrupting its governance model or existing AWS and Iceberg ecosystem.
solution_summary: BMW Group uses Snowflake and Apache Iceberg on Snowflake to add fast, cost-effective compute for large operational analytics workloads inside BMW’s multi-vendor Cloud Data Hub without disrupting its governance model or existing AWS and Iceberg ecosystem. Machine, product, erp, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so analysts, operators, and business teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Apache Iceberg keeps the broader data estate interoperable while Snowflake handles the high-value analytics workloads. The platform also connects with AWS so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. BMW Group achieved 25% average cost savings and 60 data use cases running on Snowflake in 18 months.
